outcomes: The student shall be able to apply logical quantitative and qualitative reasoning in solving problems.
The student shall be able to apply the methodologies of chemistry when approaching a problem.
The student shall demonstrate a knowledge of and recognize the processes that explain natural chemical phenomena.
careers: all other areas of the physical sciences
all areas of the biological and environmental sciences
